question: When a host-seam ticket's WATCHME cannot name its receiver and goes back for fixing, where should its FIXME re-enter — (a) POCME (the host-seam's build-analogue: re-run the proof-of-concept on the host), (b) RESEARCHME, or (c) something else?
why_it_blocks: host-seam v1's path is THINKME -> TICKETME -> RESEARCHME -> POCME -> PROVEME -> PROVED with no BUILDME, so the FIXME repair edge every other watch-carrying class gets (FIXME -> BUILDME, tickets 72d2f79daf0a and 5f217a2d4bd6) has no step to re-enter; the class file cannot be written without naming one.
